t: Liqboa beraka bimqom seuda, vead kamma yakol lebarek, umi sheshshakach velo berak
s: Liqboa beraka bimqom seuda, vead kamma yakol lebarek, umi sheshshakach velo berak, ubo g' seipim: kebar nitbaer besiman qa"ch shekkol dabar hattaun beraka leacharayv bimqomo — taun lebarek acharayv qodem sheyyaaqor mimmeqomo lekattechilla. Veim shakach veaqar mimmeqomo qodem sheyyebarek — lo hitrichuhu chakamim lachazor limqomo ulebarek, ella mebarek bammaqom shennizkar. Veim chazar — hare zeh meshubbach. Abal im aqar mimmeqomo bemezid — tzarik lachazor limqomo ulebarek. Veim berak bammaqom shennizkar — yatza. Veyesh omerim sheapillu beshokeach tzarik lachazor limqomo ulebarek, veim berak bammaqom shennizkar — yatza. Ubemezid — apillu bediabad lo yatza, vetzarik lachazor ulebarek bimqomo. Uleinyan halaka, sepeq berakot lehaqel. Ubediabad shekkebar berak bammaqom shennizkar — en tzarik lachazor ulebarek bimqomo, apillu aqar mimmeqomo bemezid. Abal lekattechilla yachazor limqomo vibarek, apillu hu shogeg, im epshar lo, sheen lo ikkub mechamat hachabura shennitlavvu immo badderek veenan rotzim lehamtin alayv, sheaz yesh lismok al sebara harishona lehaqel bedibre soperim im haya shogeg. Vaapillu bemezid, im hu rachoq shead sheyyachazor limqomo yitakkel hammazon shebbemeayv velo yukal lebarek kemo sheyyitbaer besamuk — yebarek bammaqom shennizkar. Vekol zeh kesheen lo pat od, abal im yesh lo pat od — en tzarik lachazor limqomo bekol inyan, ella yokal meat pat bammaqom shennizkar vibarek birkat hammazon leacharayv, shekkol dabar hattaun beraka leacharayv bimqomo — taun bammaqom sheggamar akilato, velo bammaqom shehitchil. Vaapillu im bammaqom sheggamar eno okel kashshiur shechayyab lebarek acharayv — yesh omerim shemmebarek bammaqom sheggamar, lepi shemmikkol maqom iqqar chiyyub beraka haacharona chal alayv bammaqom sheggomer, shehare qodem sheggomer en alayv chiyyub lebarek, ella yakol leekol od kamma peamim veliptor kullan bibraka sheyyebarek libsop kullan, kol shello yitakkel hammazon ben akila laakila, ubeotah beraka yitchayyeb ap belo akila zo harishona, nimtza shechiyyub habberaka achar akila zo lo chal alayv ella kesheggomerah al daat shello leekol od ad leachar sheyyitakkel hammazon bemeayv. Veap gam zot, im achar kak nimlak lachazor veleekol — chozer, venipqa mimmennu hachiyyub lebarek ad sheyyigmor. Lepikak, kesheyyokal beb' meqomot — mebarek bammaqom sheggamar, ap al pi shekkesheggamar bammaqom harishon lo haya bedato leekol od bammaqom hashsheni. Umikkol maqom, lekattechilla eno rashshay laaqor mimmeqomo belo beraka apillu al daat lachazor veleekol bammaqom hashsheni veligmor seudato sham ulebarek birkat hammazon, ella im ken hayeta dato mittechilla lekak keshebberak "hammotzi", kemo shennitbaer besiman qa"ch. Vekol zeh mimmaqom lemaqom, abal mizzavit lezavit becheder echad, apillu hu teraqlin gadol — hakkol maqom echad hu, vaapillu lekattechilla rashshay lebarek bezavit acheret. Vaapillu mibbayit lechatzer, im roeh et meqomo — nechshab kemaqom echad, kemo shennitbaer sham. Veim akal becheder echad [bebayit] zeh al daat lebarek becheder acher bebayit zeh — epshar shemmoil mah sheddato lebarek sham kemo shemmoil im dato ligmor seudato sham, kemo shennitbaer sham. Veyesh lismok al zeh keshehammaqom sheokel bo eno naqi:

Min hattora eno chayyab lebarek achar hammazon ella im ken saba mimmennu, shenneemar "veakalta vesabota uberakta vego'". Umiddibre soperim lebarek birkat hammazon al kezayit, shehu shiur akila, abal pachot mikkezayit enah niqre[t] akila kelal. Vedin tzerup likzayit — yitbaer besiman r"y. Veim neelam mimmennu velo yada im berak birkat hammazon im lav, im akal ad shessaba — chozer umebarek missapeq, mippene shehu sapeq shel tora. Veim lav — eno chozer umebarek. Vekol maqom shechozer umebarek — tzarik lomar gam ken beraka rebiit shehi middibre soperim, kede shello yabou lezalzel bah. Veod, shekkak hayeta hattaqqana, shebbekol paam shemmebarek birkat hammazon yebarek d' berakot:

Ad ematay yakol lebarek birkat hammazon? Ad sheyyitakkel hammazon shebbemeayv. Vekamma shiuro? Kol sheeno raeb meotah akila. Umishshaa shehitchil lihyot raeb, ap al pi shello nitakkel adayin legamre, kevan shehitchil lehitakkel — shub eno mebarek. Veken leinyan shetiyya vaakilat perot, im eno tzame o raeb vetaeb leotam perot — yebarek, im eno yodea leshaer im nitakkelu. Vekol zeh kesheakal kol tzorko mehallechem o mehapperot, abal im akal meat vechapetz leekol od, ella shello haya lo yoter — bazeh i epshar leshaer kol zeman sheeno raeb vetaeb, kevan shettekep hayeta lo gam ken taava, veadderabba, baakila mamsheket lo taava yoter mimmah shehayeta lo qodem laken, vehu haddin mimmah sheyyihyeh lo achar kak kesheyyitakkel zeh hamat, veim ken en reaya kelal mittaavato shekkebar nitakkel, ella shiuro ad kede hilluk d' milin, shehu shiur shaa vechomesh, lepi mah sheyyitbaer besiman tn"t. Veyesh choleqim al shiur zeh umatzrikim lebarek miyyad baakila muetet, sheggam achar haakila hu raeb. Veim era sheshshaha achar akilato — yokal meat qodem birkat hammazon lehotzi atzmo mide sapeq, sheen anu beqiim bazeh leshaer beatzmo im eno raeb kol kak kemo shehaya bitchilla qodem sheakal, sheim hu raeb kebattechilla — vadday kebar nitakkel hammazon bemeayv, shemmi sheeno raeb veokel perot o mine metiqa letaanug — hu sheyyakol lihyot taeb lahem yoter achar haakila, ap al pi shello nitakkela mimmah shehaya taeb qodem laken, lepi shekkevan shettaam taamam — nitorer lo taava lahem. Veken apillu mi sheokel lechem veeno raeb kesheokel meat — meoreret lo akila zo taavat hammaakal, mippene sheppotachat bene meayv umarchebet otam viqabbel hammaakal achar kak leteabon. Abal mi sheakal lechem leraabono — apillu baakila muetet mityashshebet dato meat veeno raeb kol kak kemo shehaya. Vaapillu bikzayit sheen bo kede lehashib dato, mikkol maqom, eno raeb kol kak mammash kemo shehaya. Veken haokel shear maakalim lirabon. Vegam mi sheeno raeb — en haakila meoreret lo taavat hammaakal ella tekep umiyyad achar sheppatechu bene meayv, abal im shaha achar akilato — nistema itztomeka, veshub eno chapetz leekol kol kak, apillu kemo shehaya chapetz qodem sheakal. Veim achar kak chozer vetaeb meat kemo qodem sheakal — vadday bekak nitakkela akila zo, veeno yakol lebarek. Veen anu beqiim bazeh, laken lo yishheh kelal achar akila muetet qodem birkat hammazon. Veyesh lachosh ledibrehem lehaqel bispeq berakot, shello yukal lebarek ad kede hilluk d' milin kassebara harishona. Veim era sheshshaha achar akilato vechozer veokel lehotzi atzmo mide sapeq — en tzarik lebarek "hammotzi" kol shello hissiach dato, veyesh omerim apillu hissiach dato, kemo shennitbaer besiman qa"t. Abal kol shevvadday nitakkel hammazon shebberak alayv — nistalleqa beraka harishona. Veken harotzeh liptor shette akilot bibraka achat veshaha benetayim keshiur ikkul — tzarik lachazor ulebarek:
